messages.author: 3ac91e1d284ecac5
messages.subject: Interpretation results GRM
parts:
Hi Phil,

I am having some difficulties interpreting the results of a Graded Response Model. I get the following output:

            a1     d1         d2        d3         d4
item1  0.610  1.161 -0.877 -2.907     NA
item2 2.545 -1.606 -4.561 -6.705     NA
item3  1.584 -0.071 -2.676 -5.414     NA
item4 1.311 -1.023 -3.266 -4.836     NA
item5  0.932  0.678 -1.651 -4.169     NA
item6 1.361  2.470 -0.438 -3.020 -6.105
item7 1.336  0.980 -1.374 -3.603 -5.329
item8 1.767  1.132 -1.717 -3.790 -7.300

As you can see, I get estimates of d parameters instead of b parameters. Also, these d parameters decrease, while I expect them to increase. I do not understand why I get these results. I use the exact same code as I did for another scale of the measure, for which I did get b parameters that increase:

mod <- mirt(data, 1, itemtype = "graded", SE=TRUE, verbose=FALSE) 

The item and information plots look normal.

Could you help me with this?

Thank you!

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Interpretation results GRM
parts:
Have you tried using coef(mod, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify=TRUE)?

Phil
